derivation: from H4022 (מֶגֶד) and H410 (אֵל); preciousness of God;

occurrences.text: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
